name: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān Jāmī
summary: Persian poet and scholar of Herat; his commentary on al-Kāfiya, al-Fawāʾid al-ḍiyāʾiyya, is read in the Indian and Ottoman madrasas as Sharḥ Jāmī or Molla Câmî.
bio: Jāmī studied in Herat and Samarkand and became a leading figure of Timurid Herat, known above all as a Persian poet.
He wrote al-Fawāʾid al-ḍiyāʾiyya on Ibn al-Ḥājib's al-Kāfiya for his son Ḍiyāʾ al-Dīn Yūsuf. It gathered its own glosses, among them those of ʿIṣām al-Dīn and Muḥarram Efendi.
